game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Scorpion Canyon Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the desert nomad must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: In Scorpion Canyon, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the water well using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The water well reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the water well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Scorpion Canyon'. region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The water well reached with actions_used <= 21.
